kind: analysis fixed before new scientific model outcomes
cohort: Originally selected40 by two SHA-ranked IDs per WG/released-track cell. Eligibility requires explicit new task definition, typed complete reference execution within30s/2000rows. Retain all40 dispositions; no replacements based on model outcomes.
task_meaning: Explicit source-defined task variants over deposited graph records, not semantic certification or repaired-original-question performance.
primary_metrics: Macro per-task complete-record F1 under named typed fields and declared collection semantics
secondary_metrics: CLI invocation count, elapsedtime and captured usage including iterative helper
Operational abstain signals and inconsistent nonempty-record abstain flags
scorer: Public score_contract.py; JSON nested fields compared in full, preserving internal sequence. Supplemental fields are ignored except required named fields. No role/value coercion. New reference gold nested shapes are validated before eligibility.
subgroups: Original released track label, which is not certified physical path depth
Single-field vs multiple required named fields
failure_policy: Every eligible task remains in all arms. Missing/error/tool-using/timed-out predictions are empty. No automatic scientific retries or outcome-based replacement.
contrasts: iterative minus single for both primary metrics: same retained text corpus and final reader limits
structured minus single and structured minus iterative: descriptive unequal-representation/source-cutoff contrasts

uncertainty.method: Paired task bootstrap within the fixed eligible cohort, percentile95% interval
uncertainty.limitation: Unweighted source-selected small cohort; no template-cluster or population-generalization inference. No acceptance probability, significance gate or best-arm selection.

gold_and_source_limits: Deposited TTL restoration and executable formal definitions support graph-relative answers, not domain-expert truth
Current retained text corpus is not asserted to share the deposited graph cutoff
All40 original questions are preserved; unresolved original meaning is not converted into new canonical semantic gold
Graph full access versus capped text is an input asymmetry and not evidence of unique graph-storage benefit
Operational abstain signal on this cohort is not missing-evidence abstention evaluation
No independent expert validation or outside-RAN transfer study
